candidates.text:
Not to mention that they are quite literally not the same.

"You can't tell the difference between a lab-grown diamond and a natural diamond!"

Not true.

A shitty jeweler can't, but a high-end jeweler absolutely can. They have specialized machines just for this.

Otherwise, I would be in the diamond business selling lab-grown diamonds at natural stone prices lol

Lab-grown diamonds are essentially too perfect, and that's how they're able to tell them apart. 

They use a process called photoluminescence spectroscopy that sees how light reflects off the diamond. 

Natural diamonds have irregular growth patterns, while lab-grown diamonds have specific shapes.
